title: What If the Polar Vortex Split in Two?

scenes.text: What if the polar vortex split in two? On the ground, nothing seems to change at first.
Miles above the pole, the air can warm by up to 50 degrees Celsius in just a few days.
The spinning ring of wind tears into smaller vortices, and the weather below stays calm.
Then the jet stream shifts south, and the cold signal can reach the ground in days or weeks.
In 2018, a split was followed about two weeks later by the Beast from the East, a severe cold outbreak over Europe.
About two thirds of these events change surface weather, so the warmest air up there can bring the coldest air down here.

description:
What if the polar vortex split in two?
Air miles above the pole can warm by up to 50 degrees Celsius in days, and the cold can reach the ground weeks later.
